code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and neutropenia, with relative monocytosis and basophilia. There is also mild metabolic acidosis (low CO₂, high chloride). Renal and liver function, as well as glucose and protein levels, are within normal limits. Findings suggest possible infection, bone marrow suppression, or hematologic disorder; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
